name: nyoncode/wire-suite
description: The whole wire stack in one require, with an interactive installer.

suggest.nyoncode/wire-module-users: User administration, with roles where the application has them.
suggest.nyoncode/wire-module-audit: A screen for the audit trail wire-core already records.
suggest.nyoncode/wire-module-notifications: The history behind the notification bell.
suggest.nyoncode/wire-module-settings: Typed application settings with a page to edit them.
suggest.nyoncode/wire-module-media: A media library with uploads and previews.
suggest.nyoncode/laravel-permission-extended: Roles and wildcard permissions, used by the users module.
